newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD AND PSV PLAY OUT TENSE 0-0 DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD AND PSV PLAY OUT TENSE 0-0 DRAW.

text.p: Feyenoord Rotterdam and PSV Eindhoven played out a tense 0-0 draw in Rotterdam on Sunday, leaving PSV still three points clear in the Dutch league with ten matches to play.
An understrength PSV will leave Feyenoord's de Kuip stadium the more satisfied, but the match extended Feyenoord's unbeaten home record against PSV to 11 matches.

Feyenoord had more chances with their Swedish midfielder Henryk Larsson one of very few players capable of finding time in a packed midfield. His colleagues were, however, unable to dispatch a number of clear chances.

The blunted PSV attack posed few challenges for a tight Feyenoord defence, regimented by Dutch international Ronald Koeman. The absence of PSV's Belgian striker Luc Nilis, due to an ankle injury, left PSV with no central target.
